notes: Optional: the extension and Skill live in the standalone Package components/rex, which works on its own in plain PiG without this Piglet.

The rex Go extension is completely inert unless REX_BLOCK is set (non-empty) and rex is on PATH. On session_start it runs `rex whoami --autostart=false --json` once with a 2 s deadline and injects one system-prompt context line.
No tools and no status/resume hooks are registered: PiG already ships OSC 7501 program status and OSC 7577 program resume for Rex.
The pigpen-rex Skill directs the agent to run `rex skill show` rather than copying Rex's own guide, so instructions stay matched to the installed Rex version.

The manifest lists five build targets, but only linux/amd64 has been built and validated; linux/arm64, darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64 and windows/amd64 are listed in the manifest only, so no platform is a support claim.
